speech.heard: Netherlands has 83.3% active youth. Djibouti has 13.4%. Djibouti is the world's lowest. It counts everyone who supplies labor. USA has 50.8%, and China has 49.3%. Nigeria has 64.8%, 3.9 times the proportion in Libya. Climbing higher, Australia's 70.2%, Madagascar's 72.4% and Iceland 82.1%. Netherlands is the world's highest, 83.3% are active. What keeps youth active in the labor force where you live?
differences: base.en: '(nothing)' heard as 'is' after 'climbing higher australia'
